liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (4 reviews): Reviewer says this version still gives them goosebumps; Reviewer praises the Scarlet into Fire pairing as superb, with a very tight band [13][14][19][20]
- **If I Had The World To Give** (2 reviews): Reviewer enjoys the exploration at the end of the song and laments that it stops; Reviewer lists this song among the show's highlights [14][20]
- **Mama Tried** (1 review): Weir joins Mama Tried directly to Mexicali Blues, which reviewer sees as treating two minor songs as one [18]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer's first-ever Grateful Dead song heard was this Jack Straw, which began their love of the band [13]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Estimated Prophet into Eyes Of The World is singled out as a strong stretch of the second set [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **If I Had The World To Give**: rare: 5 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-10-17.sbd.miller.89257.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 4.58/5 by 12 [1]
- **gd1978-10-17.138919.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.138919.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1978-10-17.sbd.nugs.21243.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 149 min [5]
- **gd1978-10-17.mtx.motb-0092.100699.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 143 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd78-10-17.sbd.unknown.1078.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 149 min; rated 4.26/5 by 19 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls Garcia's guitar exceptionally crisp and clean, and says the recording sounds top notch overall; There are a few muffled stretches and spots where the taper seems to have lapsed; As a soundboard, it captures onstage banter and jokes among the band [15][23]

## Around the show

- Slides from the band's Egypt trip were projected on a huge screen above the stage during the second set [12]
- A woman onstage near the end of the drum solo asked Garcia for banjo lessons; he declined twice, and Weir called her busted [12]
- Reviewer notes this opened a run of shows at Winterland, right after the Egypt trip [18]
- Reviewer remembers the slideshow of the band's Egypt trip during the show [19]
- Banjo lesson exchange between a person onstage and Garcia can be heard on the recording [23]
- During Space, Garcia can be heard offstage being asked whether he still gives banjo lessons [3]
- Reviewer says it was among the first shows after the band got back from Egypt [12]
- Reviewer finds the first set sleepy, but the second set short and powerful [17]
- Reviewer feels each tune in the Scarlet, Fire, Estimated, Eyes sequence once shone more on its own [18]
- Unlike other reviewers, this one likes the first set, and finds Garcia's playing amazing in places [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-10-17.sbd.miller.89257.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [1]. Also: The DAT was labeled SBD but the chain is master reel to PCM to DAT; Patch material came from Pat Lee and was transferred by Matt Smith [1]
- **gd1978-10-17.138919.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.138919.sbeok.flac16**: taped by From Gastwirt Collection; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: Soundboard > Master Reel > PCM > Dat (44k); Provided by Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Panasonic SV-3700 > Tascam DA-3000 . wav 16/44.1; Transferred by… [3]. Also: Patch source is an audience tape by Reinhart Holwein, using an AKG D224e and Sony TC-158, equalized to match [3]
- **gd1978-10-17.sbd.nugs.21243.sbeok.flac16**: source: SBD>Master Reel>Cassette>DAT>WAV [5]. Also: All five run shows come from soundboards of varying quality, with some splices and cassette cuts [5]
- **gd1978-10-17.mtx.motb-0092.100699.flac16**: transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [6]. Also: Matrix mix of 55% audience and 45% soundboard, using the C. Miller soundboard, shnid 89257 [6]
- **gd78-10-17.sbd.unknown.1078.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [11]
